bio.text: John Vander Woude is a Republican who represents District 22 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in an eighth term; the directory lists Vander Woude's occupation as farmer.
The legislature's biography says Vander Woude served one earlier term in the House, 2006 to 2008, and served 16 years on the Nampa Christian School Board.
It also lists Vander Woude as a former board member of the United Dairymen of Idaho, Milk Producers of Idaho and the Idaho Dairy Herd Improvement Association.
